basic_details.job_title: Saheed Kshudiram College Invigilator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Saheed Kshudiram College, Kamakhyaguri, Alipurduar, is looking for invigilators for its forthcoming B.A. Semester Examination 2026. Candidates who have passed P.G. with at least 55% marks in P.G. can apply. A fresh application, with the P.G. mark sheet and a contact number that has WhatsApp, has to be submitted to the Principal of the college by 22 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Saheed Kshudiram College
content_sections.text: Saheed Kshudiram College is in Kamakhyaguri, Alipurduar (PIN 736202). Its letterhead says it is affiliated to the University of North Bengal, recognised by the U.G.C. under 2(f) and 12(B), and accredited by NAAC with Grade 'B+'. The Principal of the college signed this notice on 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes to "the undersigned", who signed the notice as the Principal, Saheed Kshudiram College, Kamakhyaguri, Alipurduar. The college address printed on the letterhead is Saheed Kshudiram College, Kamakhyaguri, Alipurduar, PIN-736202. The notice asks for a fresh application. It does not prescribe an application form and does not say whether the application should be sent by post or handed in. It must be submitted by 22 November 2026. For enquiries, the letterhead gives phone number 03564 260419 and the email [email protected] . The notice does not say that applications may be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for invigilators only and does not print the number of posts. The eligibility it prints is: Educational qualification: P.G. passed. Minimum marks: at least 55% marks in P.G. Contact: the applicant must give a contact number that has WhatsApp. The notice does not mention any age limit, experience or pay for invigilators. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.
